title: Mr. Garagasa
desc: Muniya, a chatterbox, often meets a producer who has several personal problems. However, using ingenious ways, he helps the man get rid of his issues.

title: Sirai
desc: A police officer escorts a prisoner from Vellore prison to Sivagangai court. However, unexpected interactions occur between the two during the long transit, challenging their perspectives.

title: Rambo 2
desc: Mayuri gets kidnapped when she is on a road trip with her friends, Krishna and DJ. However, the kidnapper releases her with a message for Krishna, whom he wants to kill.

title: The Villain
desc: Ramu sets out to find his estranged brother, Rama, to reunite him with their mother. However, Ramu soon discovers that Rama is a mafia don, which makes it difficult for Ramu to approach his brother.

title: Thavarina Siri
desc: Muttanna bravely navigates life's challenges to provide for his family while staying true to his humanitarian heart. Despite their struggles, he selflessly takes care of others.
